notes.title: Digimon Story Time Stranger is coming soon!
notes.content:
Explore the deep bond between humans and Digimon!

Digimon Story Time Stranger is an RPG with monster-taming elements that explores the deep bond between humans and Digimon in an epic story that unravels the mystery of the world’s collapse.

Discover the trailer now 🔽

[previewyoutube=anPV_mRq8Lc;full][/previewyoutube]

Embark on a mission where chance encounters with unique characters will shape your journey across time and parallel worlds. 
Collect, raise and customize a diverse array of Digimon to tackle challenges in your own way.

Learn more :

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1984270/Digimon_Story_Time_Stranger/
